notes: Paper reports strongest 3σ bound on axion-photon coupling over 8-25 eV mass range from γ-ray attenuation measurements. Best-fit parameters: m_a c^2 = 9.1 eV, g_aγ = 2.1 × 10^-11 GeV^-1 (2.1σ preference over null). The bound is mass-independent (flat) over the stated 8-25 eV range, so encoded as horizontal line. Paper uses 739 blazars from Fermi-LAT and 38 from ground-based Cherenkov telescopes. This is an astrophysical/cosmological bound (not a haloscope), so no local DM density is set. Confidence level set to 0.95 as standard for 3σ exclusion limits. | selector: text (sole candidate)
